Lessons.Title: Series and their Notations
ExplanationParagraphs: Series sum successive terms; arithmetic sum S_n=n(a1+an)/2.
Finite geometric sum a1(1−r^n)/(1−r), r≠1; if r=1, S_n=n a1.
Infinite geometric sum exists for |r|<1 and equals a1/(1−r).
A repeating block of decimal digits can be converted into a rational geometric series.
An annuity with regular end-period payments P and periodic interest i has future value P((1+i)^n−1)/i.
Independent Cool-down: calculate a representative source-family example and check the result with the definition.
